AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Urban and peri-urban Agriculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.

5. D — Glucose and oxygen

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.

7. A — Producers

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.

9. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

12. C — 100 °C

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Health: Disease Control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
